 Islanders at Ducks projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 14, 2026 
 Link copied 
 ISLANDERS (8-6-4) at DUCKS (10-8-1) 
 10 p.m. ET; FOXLA+, Prime Video, MSGSN 
 Islanders projected lineup 
 Simon Holmstrom -- Bo Horvat -- Kyle Palmieri
 Emil Heineman -- Mathew Barzal -- Victor Eklund
 Ondrej Palat -- Brayden Schenn -- Anthony Duclair
 Matias Maccelli -- Casey Cizikas -- Mitchell Chaffee
 Logan Stanley -- Matthew Schaefer
 Adam Pelech – Ryan Pulock
 Ben Hutton -- Tony DeAngelo 
 Semyon Varlamov
 Ilya Sorokin
 Scratched: Scott Mayfield, Matthew Kessel 
 Injured: Jean-Gabriel Pageau (lower body), Alexander Romanov (torn right ACL), Cal Ritchie (lower body) 
 Ducks projected lineup 
 Judd Caulfield -- Leo Carlsson -- Troy Terry
 Cutter Gauthier -- Mikael Granlund -- Beckett Sennecke
 Jeff Malott -- Tim Washe -- Alex Killorn 
 Nikita Nesterenko -- Roger McQueen -- Sam Colangelo
 Jackson LaCombe -- Drew Helleson
 Tyson Hinds -- Tristan Luneau
 Pavel Mintyukov -- Noah Warren
 Lukas Dostal
 Ville Husso; 
 Scratched: Travis Mitchell, Frank Vatrano 
 Injured: A.J. Greer (upper body), Ian Moore (lower body), Ryan Poehling (MCL) 
 Status report 
 Barzal will make his season debut after recovering from left knee inflammation; Islanders coach Pete DeBoer was still determining the lineup following the morning skate and had not decided whether to dress 11 forwards and seven defensemen or go with a traditional 12/6 configuration. ... Pageau will be a game-time decision; the forward missed a 5-2 win at the Los Angeles Kings on Thursday with an injury that occurred during the morning skate. ... Varlamov did not participate in the morning skate and likely will start. ... New York placed forward Kyle MacLean on non-roster waivers Saturday. ... The Ducks did not hold a morning skate. ... Terry moved up to the top line after making his season debut on the third line in a 4-2 loss to the Nashville Predators on Wednesday. ... Anaheim returned goalie Laurent Brossoit to San Diego of the American Hockey League on Friday.
